transaction.notes: High bits of MTreg (example: 01000_100 for MTreg=0x8A)

steps.notes: Write high bits of measurement time register. Opcode is 01000_MT[7,6,5].

operation_flows.notes: MTreg high bits (bits 7-5) are sent as opcode 01000_MT[7,6,5].

transaction.notes: Low bits of MTreg (example: 011_01010 for MTreg=0x8A)

steps.notes: Write low bits of measurement time register. Opcode is 011_MT[4,3,2,1,0].

operation_flows.notes: MTreg low bits (bits 4-0) are sent as opcode 011_MT[4,3,2,1,0].

steps.notes: Enter low power mode.

raw_encoding.notes: 16-bit unsigned raw counts from Data Register.

registers_or_commands.name: Data Register
registers_or_commands.description: 16-bit register storing ambient light measurement result. Initial value 0x0000.

registers_or_commands.name: Measurement Time Register
registers_or_commands.description: 8-bit register for measurement time adjustment. Default 69 decimal (0x45).

bitfields.name: MTreg
bitfields.description: Measurement time register value. Range 31 to 254 decimal. Default 69.

init_sequence.notes: Power-up: DVI must be held low for at least 1µs after VCC supply for asynchronous reset.
After DVI goes high, device is in power down mode. Send Power On command (0x01) if needed.

read_sequence.notes: Read sequence depends on measurement mode. See operation_flows for details.

error_conditions.condition: I2C NACK during write or read

error_conditions.detection: Elapsed time exceeds maximum measurement time (180ms for H-resolution, 24ms for L-resolution)

power_states.name: power_down
power_states.description: Low power mode, no measurement active. Current ~0.01 µA typical.

power_states.name: power_on
power_states.description: Active mode, waiting for measurement command. Current ~120 µA typical.

power_states.name: measuring
power_states.description: Measurement in progress. Current similar to power_on.

evidence_spans.snippet: Slave Address is 2 types, it is determined by ADDR Terminal ADDR = 'H' (ADDR ≥ 0.7VCC ) → '1011100' ADDR = 'L' (ADDR ≤ 0.3VCC ) → '0100011'
Instruction Set Architecture table: Power Down 0000_0000, Power On 0000_0001, Reset 0000_0111, Continuously H-Resolution Mode 0001_0000, etc.
Measurement Mode explanation: H-resolution Mode2 Typ. 120ms. 0.5 lx, H-Resolution Mode Typ. 120ms. 1 lx., L-Resolution Mode Typ. 16ms. 4 lx.
How to calculate when the data High Byte is "10000011" and Low Byte is "10010000" ( 2 15 + 2 9 + 2 8 + 2 7 + 2 4 ) / 1.2 ≒ 28067 [ lx ]
H-reslution mode : Illuminance per 1 count ( lx / count )    = 1 / 1.2 *( 69 / X )
H-reslution mode2 : Illuminance per 1 count ( lx / count )    = 1 / 1.2 *( 69 / X ) / 2
changable range of MTreg binary 0001_1111 ( sensitivity : default * 0.45 ) ... 0100_0101 default ... 1111_1110 ( sensitivity : default * 3.68 )
H-Resolution Mode Measurement Time t HR Typ. 120 ms Max. 180 ms
L-Resolution Mode Measurement Time t LR Typ. 16 ms Max. 24 ms
I2C SCL Clock Frequency f SCL Max. 400 kHz
DVI is I2C bus reference voltage terminal. And it is also asynchronous reset terminal. It is necessary to set to 'L' after VCC is supplied.
DVI Terminal: please set to 'L' ( at least 1µs, DVI <= 0.4V ) after VCC is supplied.
Data Register → This is for registration of Ambient Light Data. Initial Value is "0000_0000_0000_0000".
Measurement Time Register → This is for registration of measurement time. Initial Value is "0100_0101".
Reset command is for only reset Illuminance data register. ( reset value is '0' )
"Power On" Command is possible to omit.
BH1750FVI is not able to accept plural command without stop condition. Please insert SP every 1 Opecode.
Wait to complete 1st    H-resolution mode measurement.( max. 180ms. )
It is possilbe to detect 0.23lx by using this function at H-resolution mode. And it is possilbe to detect 0.11lx by using this function at H-resolution mode2.

requires_human: ADDR pin connection determines slave address; must be set before I2C communication.
DVI pin must be held low for at least 1µs after VCC supply for proper reset.
Measurement time adjustment via MTreg affects sensitivity and measurement duration; formula depends on mode.
One-time modes automatically power down after measurement; continuous modes require explicit power down if needed.
